title: nutty chewy Russian new potatoes borscht
description: a hearty russian-inspired dish featuring new potatoes, deglazed with a mixture of vegetable broth and vinegar, to create a nutty and chewy texture, making it an ideal hangover cure.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
add the caraway seeds and dried dill weed, and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the chopped potatoes, vegetable broth, water, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
use a slotted spoon to remove the potatoes from the saucepan, and mash them slightly with a fork.
return the potatoes to the saucepan, and stir in the apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, and chopped onion.
continue to simmer for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has thickened and the potatoes are coated in a sticky glaze.
taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
serve hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill, if desired.
